decks.name: New Player Joins the Party
decks.description: A short deck for folding a new character into an established group without an awkward 'you all meet at a tavern' restart. It leans hard on relationships and shared memory so the newcomer arrives already tangled in the party's history, then leaves a single unresolved question hanging over them. Run it in the session a new player joins.
focus: Give the new character existing connections.
Create at least one shared memory.
Give the party a reason to trust (or question) them.
Leave one unresolved mystery involving the newcomer.

phases.name: History
phases.description: The past that shaped the present.

decks.name: After a Year of Downtime
decks.description: For picking a campaign back up after significant in-world time has passed. The deck focuses on relationships and the community as they are now, surfacing what changed while the characters were away, then layers fresh opportunities and problems on top. Run it to reconnect the party with the people and places that matter before pushing them into whatever comes next.
focus: Introduce new opportunities and new problems.

phases.description: Power and the struggle over it.
